description: On the table in front of you there’s a white square base or tray with round corner sockets, and a separate white peg-like connector piece nearby. The left hand comes in to steady the base, while the right hand picks up the connector and moves it over the base, lowering it straight down into a corner socket and pressing it in with small up-and-down adjustments; the base is a left-hand object and the connector is a right-hand object.
